patches: gui/patches/terminal-runner.patch: typed application runner with unchanged platform I/O
gui/patches/terminal-caret.patch: invert the clipped caret cell without replacing placeholder or editor glyphs
gui/patches/sdl-runner.patch: typed application runner and injected test observer; removes demonstration actions
gui/patches/rev-build.patch: explicit dependency root and reusable targets without upstream demonstration or install rules
gui/patches/rev-dependencies.patch: explicit preserved archive root
gui/patches/rev-pointer.patch: physical raw pointer phases with stable capture and transparent inert text; ordinary toolkit controls retain native input
gui/patches/rev-pointer-probe.patch: native phase input seam for focused retained Rev gesture qualification
gui/patches/fltk-appearance.patch: generic flat shared-palette controls and matching monospaced font class; native event handling retained
gui/patches/fltk-pointer.patch: physical raw pointer phases with stable capture and transparent inert text; ordinary toolkit controls retain native input
gui/patches/fltk-service-focus.patch: active native prompt retains keyboard and clipboard focus across synchronization; main-window focus resumes after completion
gui/patches/contract-portability.patch: explicit callback target binding for portable synchronous acknowledgment test; assertions retained
gui/patches/adapter-portability.patch: explicit metrics callback target binding; mutation and recursion assertions retained
gui/patches/web-ordering.patch: only adjacent compatible browser edits coalesce; commands preserve ordering barriers
gui/patches/web-ordering-test.patch: retained renderer tests use the patched module and verify delayed edit/action ordering
gui/patches/web-tick.patch: authenticated ordered poll invokes bounded application work on the owning thread
gui/patches/web-lifecycle.patch: bounded single outstanding poll and owned session/dialog/timer teardown
gui/patches/web-assets.patch: explicit retained asset routes and exact child script hash in inherited hosted CSP
gui/patches/rev-conformance-scale.patch: supplier bitmap assertions map logical sample points to actual capture pixels without changing expected colors
gui/patches/rev-clipboard-ownership.patch: synchronize fixture selection ownership across native connections and require a malformed reply without weakening rejection assertions
gui/patches/touch-contract.patch: contact identity, move/release/cancel phases and bounded pointer validation
gui/patches/touch-memory.patch: capture routing beyond target bounds with revocation on lifecycle changes
gui/patches/touch-interaction.patch: exactly-once release activation and generation-bound touch ownership
gui/patches/file-services.patch: bounded owned text import/export capabilities
gui/patches/web-file-services.patch: browser-owned file selection and download capability
gui/patches/web-responsiveness.patch: bounded measurement scheduling and retained keyed rows
gui/patches/web-presentation.patch: ordered state acceptance with coalesced visual presentation
gui/patches/web-file-transfer.patch: bounded ordered browser content chunks with service ownership and explicit abort
gui/patches/web-split.patch: separate renderer DOM implementation from trusted transport and services; compatibility exports retained
gui/patches/web-embedding.patch: select isolated or standalone browser composition before loading renderer code
